reviews.comment: Dr. Li is a super smart professor that is very knowledgable about business. He really cares a lot about what the students need and will listen to your concerns. Sometimes he'll lose you when he's lecturing but can be really engaging at times.
Toby is a great professor and keeps it real with his students. Good insights into the business world as well as some life lessons. Would definitely recommend taking any of his classes.

Toby is a great professor. He's super smart and really knows business concepts. Sometimes his lectures can lose you when they go on for a while, but for the most part he's very engaging. Does a great job caring about what his students want from the class.

Li values participation during lecture, and wants all to learn. There's a group case-study presentation, and final paper. Other hw is case readings and class lectures. I was not a big fan of his lectures; full of filler words and lacking true substance/value. He does not have much experience living the topics, but can convey the concepts decently.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Li is an amazing professor. He has years of experience, and transmits valuable insights to his students . He explains concepts clearly and welcomes questions. He is accessible to help his students. He provides valuable feedback and promotes growth and learning. Would take again Dr. Li again because of his determination and friendliness.

Just take this class. Inspirational lectures which are really class discussions where you are free to provide your opinion and a really friendly atmosphere. I'm gonna miss this class since I've finished it I really appreciate his willingness to help out with all kinds of things.
